title: AUGUR deployment settings
$comment: Every setting a deployment can set in infra/deploy/.env, and every one AUGUR's services read, described once. As a JSON Schema it describes .env as an object of strings: `required`, `default`, and `writeOnly` for a secret. AUGUR's own keywords: `x-services`, the compose services that read it (`compose` for Docker Compose itself); `x-via`, for a service that gets it another way (a compose file of its own such as identity-repair.yml, `.env` when it reads the deployment's .env itself, or `default` when it keeps its own default in a deployment); `x-docs`, the guide section that explains it; `x-internal`, for one compose or the code sets and nobody puts in .env; `x-generate`, for a secret nobody needs to know, which `node scripts/preflight.mjs --install --fill-secrets` makes (64 random hex characters). `pattern`, `minLength`, `enum` and `format` are checked by the install preflight. `pnpm check:settings` (scripts/check-settings.mjs) holds compose.yml, .env.example, the guides and the services' code to it.

^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*_DATABASE_PASSWORD$.description: An app's own database login, for an app named in APP_STORAGE: <ID> is its id in capitals with _ for -.

^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*_BUCKET_SECRET$.description: An app's own bucket key (64 hex), for an app named in APP_STORAGE.

PLATFORM_VERSION.description: The AUGUR release this server runs, such as 0.1.1.

PLATFORM_IMAGES.description: Where the images come from, for a mirror in your own registry. The default is the publisher's image path, an old id kept on purpose (AGENTS.md, Names).

TS_HOSTNAME.description: The machine's name on the tailnet.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Postgres's admin login, used only by the storage job and backups.

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Keycloak's own admin's password, read by Keycloak on its first start and by identity's realm job (keycloak-config) on every up.

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USER.description: Keycloak's own admin, the way back in if every deployment admin loses their one-time code.

EVENTS_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: The events service's own database login.

MODELS_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: The model gateway's own database login.

GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Garage's admin API token, which the storage job makes buckets with.

FRONTENDS_BUCKET_SECRET.description: The registry's key to the bucket apps' frontends are kept in by version (64 hex).

APP_SECRETS_KEY.description: The key every app's database, bucket and sign-in secrets are worked out from; with the updater, it turns the app runner on.

APP_PUBLISHERS.description: Who else may sign the apps the app runner installs: owner/repo or owner/repo/.github/workflows/<file>, space separated.

APPS_NETWORK.description: The Docker network the app runner puts apps on (default: the updater's own, usually platform_default).

MODELS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The model gateway's own sign-in; needed before models can be used.

ATLAS_BUCKET_SECRET.description: Data Atlas's bucket key (made for every app; Data Atlas keeps nothing there). Worked out from APP_SECRETS_KEY when unset.

MANDATE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Mandate's own sign-in. On a server whose app runner installed Mandate before, the updater sets it to the one the runner gave it.

MANDATE_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Mandate's own database login. On a server whose app runner installed Mandate before, the updater sets it to the one the runner gave it, so its data stays.

MANDATE_BUCKET_SECRET.description: Mandate's bucket key (made for every app; Mandate keeps nothing there). Worked out from APP_SECRETS_KEY when unset.

PLATFORM_ADMIN_USER.description: The first person who can sign in; identity gives them the deployment-admin role when nobody has it.

PLATFORM_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: That person's password, for the first sign-in only.

ORG_NAME.description: What the organisation is called at first start. After that an admin changes it in Admin, Organisation (ADR 0042); the sign-in pages still read it.

ORG_PRODUCT_NAME.description: What people see the product called: the browser tab, the sign-in pages and emails (the realm's display name).

SMTP_HOST.description: The organisation's SMTP relay. Empty: AUGUR sends no email, offers no password reset or address check, and says so.

SMTP_PORT.description: The relay's port. Empty: 587, or 465 with SMTP_SECURITY tls.

SMTP_SECURITY.description: starttls (the default), tls from the start, or none for a relay on a trusted network.

SMTP_FROM.description: The address email comes from, which the relay must accept. The product's name is shown as the sender.

SMTP_REPLY_TO.description: Where replies go, if not to SMTP_FROM.

SMTP_USER.description: The relay's sign-in, if it wants one.

ORG_LOGO_URL.description: A link to the organisation's logo, shown on the sign-in pages and in emails. Empty shows none.

BACKUP_HOUR_UTC.description: The hour (UTC) the nightly backup is taken.

BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS.description: How many days of backups are kept.

RESTORE_TEST_WEEKDAY.description: The day the weekly restore test runs (0 is Sunday).

OFFSITE_REPOSITORY.description: The restic repository in an S3-compatible bucket that backups are copied to, off the server (ADR 0060). Empty, backups stay on the server only.

OFFSITE_PASSWORD.description: restic's encryption password for the off-server copy. Keep a copy off the server too.

OFFSITE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: The id of the bucket's key for the off-server copy.

OFFSITE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The secret of the bucket's key for the off-server copy.

OFFSITE_REGION.description: The bucket's region, if its provider wants one.

OFFSITE_KEEP_DAILY.description: How many days of copies the off-server bucket keeps.

PITR_KEEP_DAYS.description: How many days back the database can be restored to a point in time: the nightly base backups kept, here and in the off-server copy (ADR 0064).

PITR_ARCHIVE_SECONDS.description: At most how many seconds of database changes wait before Postgres archives them (ADR 0064).

MODEL_API_URL.description: An OpenAI-style API for the model behind Agents, or stand-in; without it models stay off.

MODEL_EMBEDDING_NAME.description: The model at MODEL_API_URL that turns text into vectors.

MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: How long the model gateway waits for the model to answer, in seconds.

APP_STORAGE.description: Other apps that keep their own schema and files here, space separated (the apps that ship with AUGUR are made without being named).

API_RATE_PER_SECOND.description: API requests a second from one address.

API_RATE_BURST.description: API requests let through at once from one address.

SSO_RATE_PER_SECOND.description: Sign-in requests a second from one address.

SSO_RATE_BURST.description: Sign-in requests let through at once from one address.

KEYCLOAK_CONSOLE.description: open serves Keycloak's own admin console at PLATFORM_URL/sso/admin; it's closed otherwise.

APP_ORIGINS.description: Other sites apps may load their code from, space separated.

KIT_URL.description: Where the shell and every app load the UI kit from.

FOCUS_DEPTH.description: How the shell and every app draw what's behind something in focus: veil or lens blur it, scrim only dims it, for desktops without a GPU such as virtual desktops. Unset, each app chooses (veil unless it says).

GITHUB_READ_USER.description: The GitHub account the deployment's read key (secrets/github-read-key) belongs to.

RELEASE_FEED_URL.description: Where new AUGUR releases are listed (a mirror's feed), or off.

APP_FEED_URL.description: Where new versions of apps are listed, or off.

FEED_SIGNER.description: Who must sign the release feed, as a regular expression, for AUGUR published from a fork (default: the publisher's Feed workflow, or the one in the repository the feed comes from).

SERVER_RING.description: dev (the workbench), preview or production: what kind of server this is.

RELEASE_CHANNEL.description: stable, beta or dev (default: by the server's ring).

DEPLOYMENT_TIME_ZONE.description: The time zone upgrade windows are in, such as Europe/London (UTC by default).

PIPELINE_FEED_URL.description: Where the pipeline feed is, or off.

PORTAL_URL.description: The company's Backstage, which the Upgrade Centre links to.

DEPLOYMENT_ID.description: This server's name in Backstage's catalog.

DEPLOYMENT_REPORTING.description: off turns reporting to Backstage off.

ALLOW_PR_PREVIEWS.description: on runs pull requests' builds for apps' developers on a production server too.

COMPOSE_PROFILES.description: Docker Compose's optional parts to run: updater, observability.

PLATFORM_DIR.description: The full path of infra/deploy on the server, for the updater.

IMAGE_PULL_USER.description: Before read keys: the account a read:packages token in secrets/image-pull-token belongs to.

IMAGE_SIGNER.description: Who must sign AUGUR's images and the apps the runner installs, as a certificate identity pattern, for AUGUR published from a fork (default: the publisher's Release workflow).

IMAGE_SIGNER_ISSUER.description: Who issues that identity's certificates (default: GitHub Actions).

AUGUR_DEV_SIGNER.description: Who must sign AUGUR's dev builds, which only the workbench runs (default: the dev builds workflow in IMAGE_SIGNER's repository, or the publisher's).

DOMAIN_EVENTS_KEEP_DAYS.description: How many days apps' domain events are kept.

INBOX_KEEP_DAYS.description: How many days closed inbox items are kept before they go, with their history (the audit log keeps every step).

INBOX_DONE_DAYS.description: How many days back the Inbox's Done tab looks for closed items. Keep it at most INBOX_KEEP_DAYS, since older items are gone.

CALLER_SIGNING_KEY.description: The key the gateway signs callers with (64 hex); without it a new one is made each start.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: The OpenTelemetry collector every service sends to: the deployment's own otel-lgtm unless another is named.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS.description: Headers sent to that collector, such as its key: key=value, comma separated.

OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER.description: Which traces are kept, such as parentbased_traceidratio (default: all).

OTEL_SDK_DISABLED.description: true turns OpenTelemetry off in every service and the shell's browser errors, whatever else is set.

OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG.description: The sampler's argument, such as 0.1 to keep one trace in ten.

SERVICE_CALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: How long one service waits for another before saying it can't be reached (calls to the model gateway and frontend uploads get longer).

DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: How long one database query may run before Postgres cancels it (0 for no limit; migrations are never limited).

SEED_ALLOWED.description: true lets a deployment admin fill this deployment with synthetic sample data (pnpm seed). Never where real people work.

GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Grafana's admin password (otel-lgtm), at least 16 characters. Required, as Grafana would otherwise take admin/admin. The updater makes it up on upgrade.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN.description: Grafana's key to tell deployment admins of an alert through the registry. The updater makes it up on upgrade.

NODE_ENV.description: production in every image and compose service.

PORT.description: The port a service listens on.

DATABASE_URL.description: A service's Postgres address and login, made from its *_DATABASE_PASSWORD.

GATEWAY_URL.description: Where the gateway is, for the key it signs callers with.

OIDC_ISSUER.description: The sign-in service as tokens name it: PLATFORM_URL/sso/realms/platform.

OIDC_INTERNAL_URL.description: The sign-in service as services reach it inside Docker.

OIDC_JWKS_URL.description: Where the sign-in service's signing keys are, as the gateway reaches them.

OIDC_AUDIENCE.description: The audience people's tokens are issued for.

OIDC_TOKEN_URL.description: Where a service fetches its own tokens (default: from OIDC_INTERNAL_URL).

APP_MANIFEST.description: An app service's manifest file (default: the manifest.json its build put beside the code).

APP_FRONTEND.description: The folder holding an app service's built frontend, which it publishes at start (default: frontend/ beside the code).

SERVICE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: A service's own sign-in secret, from its *_CLIENT_SECRET.

SERVICE_CLIENT_SECRETS.description: Every platform service's and shipped app's sign-in secret, for identity's realm job (keycloak-config) to make their Keycloak clients.

KEYCLOAK_REALM.description: The Keycloak realm people sign in to: platform, an old id kept on purpose.

BACKUP_DIR.description: Where the backup container writes its results, for Status.

PUBLIC_ACCESS_FILE.description: What infra/deploy/public.sh writes when AUGUR is open to the internet, for Status.

APP_UPSTREAMS.description: The shipped apps' services, name=url, comma separated.

PILLAR_APPS.description: The apps that ship with AUGUR, which register themselves.

FRONTENDS_BUCKET.description: The bucket apps' frontends are kept in (augur-frontends).

GITHUB_READ_KEY.description: The deployment's read key, read from secrets/github-read-key.

GITHUB_READ_KEY_FILE.description: Where the read key's file is (default /run/secrets/augur/github-read-key).

RELEASE_FEED_TOKEN.description: Before read keys: a token for GitHub's releases API.

RELEASE_FEED_TOKEN_FILE.description: Before read keys: where that token's file is (default /run/secrets/augur/release-feed-token).

AUGUR_BUILD.description: source when the images are built from a checkout, for the Upgrade Centre.

DOCKER_HOST.description: The Docker API the updater drives (the docker-proxy).

GARAGE_ADMIN_URL.description: Garage's admin API, for the storage job.

GARAGE_S3_URL.description: Garage's S3 API, for the storage job (default http://garage:3900).

PLATFORM_DATABASE_LOGINS.description: The platform services that get a database login of their own.

APP_DATABASE_HOST.description: The database host apps are told to use (default: DATABASE_URL's).

APP_STORAGE_DROP.description: A pull request preview's scratch storage to take away, set by the app runner for one run of the storage job.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: An app's bucket secret, from its *_BUCKET_SECRET.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: An app's bucket key id (default: worked out from its secret).

CALLER_KEYS_URL.description: Where a service fetches the gateway's caller key, for an app hosted outside the compose network (default: from GATEWAY_URL).

APP_PREVIEW.description: The pull request an app's service is a preview of, set by the app runner.

APP_REGISTERED_BY.description: runner when the app runner registers an app, set by the app runner.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT.description: A collector for traces only (default: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT's).

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: A service's name in traces (default: its package's).

REALM_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH.description: The shortest password Keycloak accepts; at least 15 (a deployment can be stricter, never looser).

REALM_PASSWORD_DENYLIST.description: The breached-password list, a file in infra/deploy/keycloak/password-blacklists.

REALM_SESSION_IDLE_HOURS.description: Hours unused after which a session ends; 8 at most.

REALM_SESSION_MAX_HOURS.description: Hours after which a session ends whatever; 10 at most.

REALM_LANGUAGES.description: The languages offered at sign-in and in Account, comma separated, the first the default (say en,de,fr). Empty offers English only.

LOG_MAX_SIZE.description: The largest each container log file grows before Docker starts a new one.

LOG_MAX_FILES.description: How many log files Docker keeps per container.

KEYCLOAK_MEM_LIMIT.description: Keycloak's memory limit; it sizes its Java heap from it.

FOLIO_WORKER_MEM_LIMIT.description: The memory limit of Artifacts' rendition worker.

OTEL_LGTM_MEM_LIMIT.description: The memory limit of the observability stack.

OTEL_LGTM_REPLICAS.description: 0 stops the deployment's own otel-lgtm, when an organisation's collector takes its place.
